summary: Iteration_4 e2e validation of the big platform-wide refactor (companyId nullable, cross-company radius dispatch, no company picker in customer flow). Backend pytest: 20/20 PASS (5 new platform-booking tests + 15 regression tests from iteration_3). Frontend e2e via Playwright: PASS – Landing page shows 3 customer CTAs without any company picker (cta-jetzt-bestellen / cta-spaeter-bestellen visible; cta-anrufen hidden because NEXT_PUBLIC_PLATFORM_PHONE='' which is correct fallback). /buchen loads with both AddressInputs (address-input-pickup + address-input-dest). The iteration_3 lat/lng-wipe regression is FIXED: typing 'Hauptbahnhof Hannover' + clicking the autocomplete suggestion + repeating for destination 'Kröpcke Hannover' yields a working quote-price ('5,68 € – 7,26 €') and the route map renders. After filling Name+Telefonnummer the booking-continue button enables. Clicking it brings the user to Schritt 2/2 with [data-testid='booking-confirm'] container + [data-testid='confirm-booking'] button. Clicking confirm-booking creates a booking via POST /api/bookings (no company in body), returns 201 with status=OFFEN/trackingStatus=SUCHE/priceMin/priceMax > 0, and redirects to /verfolgen/<id> where tracking-banner + tracking-status are visible (status='Auftrag eingegangen – Fahrer wird gesucht'). /buchen/vorbestellung loads with the same pickup/dest inputs PLUS 2 date/time inputs (scheduled=true mode). /admin/login and /fahrer/login no longer contain any 'Demo-Zugang' / 'admin@citytaxi.de' / 'taxi123' hints – cleaned up as requested. Super-admin login form renders correctly; super@taxios.app / SuperAdmin2026! works end-to-end (verified via pytest TestSuperAdminLogin). The end-to-end cross-company dispatch (driver online → accept → companyId set) was NOT exercised in this iteration because it requires a parallel Playwright context with geolocation permissions; backend POST /api/bookings without company and dispatch-no-driver-fallback was however verified.

minor.issue: Asymmetric response shape – POST returns booking at top level, GET wraps it inside a 'booking' key. Not blocking but should be unified.
GET wraps pricing inside a 'pricing' key, PUT expects flat object. Pre-existing from iteration_3.

issues: Two stacked labels for each address remain: outer 'ABHOLADRESSE *' from BookingForm AND inner 'Abholadresse' inside AddressInput. The hideLabel prop now exists but is not being passed by BookingForm – minor visual redundancy only.

action_items: (Optional, low-priority) Pass hideLabel={true} from BookingForm to AddressInput so the redundant inner labels disappear.

(Optional, low-priority) Unify API response shapes: either always wrap (`{booking: ...}`, `{pricing: ...}`) or always return flat for both GET and POST/PUT. Currently POST/GET for /api/bookings and GET/PUT for /api/admin/pricing are asymmetric.

(Future test scope) Add a parallel-browser-context Playwright test that logs in as a driver with permissions=['geolocation'] + setGeolocation(52.3759, 9.7320), turns gps-share-toggle ON, switches to FREI, and asserts the cross-company driver:offer socket event reaches that driver (regardless of which company the booking belongs to). This is the actual cross-company dispatch end-to-end test that completes coverage of the iteration_4 spec.
critical_code_review_comments: AddressInput.tsx now correctly NO LONGER calls onChange(r.label) on suggestion click – the iteration_3 lat/lng-wipe regression is gone and step1→step2→/verfolgen works end-to-end as verified.

BookingForm.tsx correctly sends company=undefined to /api/bookings on the platform-wide pages – backend default pricing (TARIFF_BASE/PER_KM/PER_MIN from /app/.env) is applied and priceMin/priceMax are computed correctly.
/api/bookings still accepts a 'company' slug for backward compat (/c/<slug>/buchen). Verified via test_booking_with_company_slug_still_works.
GET /api/bookings/:id and GET /api/admin/pricing wrap response under a key while POST/PUT use a flat shape – consider unifying.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (home → /buchen → step1 → step2 → confirm → /verfolgen; /buchen/vorbestellung scheduled; admin+fahrer login no demo hints; super-admin login)

test_credentials: Super-Admin: super@taxios.app / SuperAdmin2026! – verified working. New companies are created per test run with random emails (TEST_Co_<ts>@test.com / Pass1234).
seed_data_creation: Several TEST_-prefixed bookings + TEST_Co companies were created during the pytest run and one booking (id surfaced as cmqb2szt6000tq9rjkbetgufo) from the Playwright happy-path. No driver was registered in this iteration because the end-to-end driver-acceptance flow was out of scope.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_4 architectural changes (platform-wide booking, companyId nullable, default pricing fallback, hideLabel fix in AddressInput, demo hints removed) are all verified working end-to-end at both API and UI level. The only flow NOT yet exercised end-to-end is cross-company dispatch with a real online driver – that needs a parallel Playwright browser context with geolocation permissions. The two iteration_3 regressions (BookingForm lat/lng wipe + AddressInput onChange override) are confirmed FIXED. The pytest harness now contains two files: /app/backend/tests/test_taxios_api.py (15 regression tests) and /app/backend/tests/test_platform_booking.py (5 platform-booking tests). All 20 green.
rca of the issue: n/a – iteration_3 RCA (lat/lng wipe on autocomplete click) is fixed by removing onChange(r.label) in AddressInput.tsx suggestion-onClick and by BookingForm now properly preserving coords. Reproduction of the fix verified live: quote-price element appears with computed price (5,68 € – 7,26 €) immediately after both autocomplete selections.
